content.title: Workplace Decisions and Everyday Operations
content.scenario_summary: Thirty independent workplace sentences cover password confidentiality in a subscription service; advance approval for childcare allowances; a finance team occupying a temporary office; warehouse orders allocated to drivers; client permission for a lawn redesign; installation of a theater lighting console; software renewal; an association vacancy website; newspaper conflicts of interest; pension-adviser appointments; badge scanning at a trade fair; purchase receipts for refunds; a postponed library vote; individual garden water meters; transparent jar lids; a farmers market application-deadline extension; procedures demonstrated in staff training; an overlength newspaper article; a bookshop replenishment order; recruitment pay; a fixed per-wheel bicycle alignment rate; carton durability weighed against assembly time; a market-directory application deadline; association mentoring; a funded library scanner awaiting a suitable model; an art shop selling pigments before a discontinuation announcement; comparable translation quotes; limited theater costume-change time; landscape seating oriented toward a fountain; and resizing exhibitor photographs for an online catalog.

questions.prompt: The subscription service keeps account passwords {{q1}} confidential and never includes them in reports sent to team administrators.

explanation.summary_zh: strictly confidential 表示嚴格保密，符合密碼不列入報表的說明。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 空格需要修飾 confidential 的副詞。strictly confidential 是表示資訊須嚴格保密的搭配，後半句不在管理員報表中列出密碼，進一步說明保密方式。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: heavily 表示大量地或程度很高，常見於 heavily discounted 等搭配；heavily confidential 不適合此處。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: closely 可表示密切地，如 closely monitored，但不以 closely confidential 表達嚴格保密。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: sharply 常描述急遽變動或鮮明差異，如 sharply reduced，不能在這裡表達保密程度。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: strictly 與 confidential 搭配，表示密碼受到嚴格保密，符合後半句所述的處理方式。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 選副詞時，除了詞性，也要確認它與後方形容詞的慣用搭配。

questions.prompt: Employees may use the childcare allowance {{q2}} their application is approved, but the benefit remains unavailable while approval is pending.

explanation.summary_zh: once 表示一經核准即可使用，符合等待核准期間無法使用的限制。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 句尾明說申請尚待核准時，這項福利仍無法使用，因此核准是開始使用津貼的必要界線。once 引導核准發生的時間，表示一經核准就可使用；其餘選項會讓未核准時反而可以使用。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: before 表示核准之前便可使用，與等待核准期間福利仍無法使用的明確限制矛盾。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: once 表示一經核准即可使用，正確區分等待核准與已獲核准兩種狀態。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: until 在此會表示核准之前可使用、到核准時為止，與句尾所述的等待期間不可使用相反。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: unless 表示除非；放入後會表示申請未獲核准時可以使用，與尚待核准期間不可使用的規定不符。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 選時間或條件連接詞時，要確認核准前後各自允許或禁止的行為。

questions.prompt: For the past six weeks, the finance team {{q3}} a temporary office and continues to work there during the relocation.

explanation.summary_zh: has occupied 將過去六週的使用狀態連結到現在。
explanation.reasoning_zh: For the past six weeks 表示從過去延續到現在的期間，continues to work there 又明確指出目前仍在該處辦公。現在完成式 has occupied 符合這個持續至今的狀態。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: has occupied 是現在完成式，表示財務團隊過去六週一直使用這間臨時辦公室，目前也仍在使用。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: had occupied 需要以過去某個時間為參照；此句的期間到現在仍持續，並非截至另一個過去時間。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: will occupy 指未來將使用，與已經持續六週且目前仍在辦公的資訊不符。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: occupies 可描述目前使用某辦公室的事實，但無法在此結構中表達 for the past six weeks 所標示的持續至今期間。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 判斷完成式時，要一起確認期間的終點與句子的時間參照。

questions.prompt: The warehouse dispatcher assigns orders to drivers {{q4}} receipt of payment, and no assignment is made while payment is pending.

explanation.summary_zh: upon receipt of payment 表示收到款項時才派單，符合款項未到就不派單的規定。
explanation.reasoning_zh: receipt of payment 在此表示收到款項。後半句規定付款尚待完成時不派單，因此收到款項才是派單的觸發條件。upon 可接這個名詞片語，表示一收到款項便進行派單。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: before receipt of payment 表示收到款項之前就派單，與付款尚待完成時不得派單的規定相反。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: pending receipt of payment 表示在等待收到款項期間派單；本句後半段卻明說等待付款期間不派單。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: upon receipt of payment 表示一收到款項便派單，符合付款尚未完成時不指派訂單的限制。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: without receipt of payment 表示未收到款項也派單，與此處必須等付款完成的作業條件矛盾。

explanation.takeaway_zh: upon receipt of 表示一收到就採取行動；pending receipt of 則表示還在等待收到。

questions.prompt: The landscape architect requested the client's {{q5}} before replacing the lawn with gravel paths and drought-tolerant plants.

explanation.summary_zh: approval 是所需的名詞，表示景觀改造前須取得客戶同意。
explanation.reasoning_zh: requested 的受詞是 the client's approval。所有格 client's 在這裡限定所請求的事物，而 approval 正好表示核准或同意，符合改動庭園前先徵得同意的情境。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: approving 可作分詞或動名詞，但單獨放在這裡無法自然指稱客戶對改造案的核准。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: approval 是名詞，the client's approval 表示客戶的核准，是 requested 的完整受詞。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: approved 是過去式或過去分詞，不能在這裡單獨表示所請求的核准事項。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: approvingly 是副詞，表示以贊同的態度，不能作此處 requested 所需的受詞核心。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 先辨認動詞的受詞結構，再選出能指稱所需事物的名詞。

questions.prompt: The theater's new lighting console {{q6}} by a technician tomorrow morning, before the actors begin their first rehearsal on the main stage.

explanation.summary_zh: will be installed 表示燈光控制台明天將由技師安裝。
explanation.reasoning_zh: install 在此是安裝某設備的及物動詞，lighting console 是被安裝的設備，by a technician 則標示安裝者。明天早上的安排在此用 will be installed 表達未來被動。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: will install 是主動式，會讓控制台成為安裝者，也缺少被安裝的受詞。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: has installed 是現在完成主動式，無法表示控制台明天將被技師安裝。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: is installing 是現在進行主動式，表示主詞正在進行安裝，與設備被技師安裝的關係不符。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: will be installed 是未來被動式，正確表示控制台是技師明天要安裝的對象。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 主動或被動要依動詞與主詞的實際關係判斷，再配合時間選形式。

questions.prompt: Please {{q7}} your currently active software subscription for another year before Friday's expiration date to avoid any interruption in service.

explanation.summary_zh: renew 表示續訂，可讓目前仍有效的訂閱在週五到期前再延續一年，避免服務中斷。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 句中的訂閱目前仍有效（currently active），但將在週五到期。句子要求在到期前把訂閱再延續一年，以 to avoid any interruption in service，因此需要表示續訂的 renew。renew 是延續訂閱的有效期間，而不是暫停服務或恢復已中斷的服務。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: suspend 表示暫停；暫停目前有效的訂閱反而會中斷服務，與句中 to avoid any interruption in service 的目的相反。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: restore 表示恢復已失去或受損的狀態；句中明說訂閱目前仍有效，重點是在到期前延續，而不是恢復。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: renew 表示續訂，能在週五到期前將訂閱再延續一年，符合 to avoid any interruption in service 的目的。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: resume 表示中斷後重新開始；目前的訂閱仍有效，尚無需要恢復的中斷。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 看清服務是即將到期，還是已經中斷，再區分續訂與恢復。

questions.prompt: The professional association's website is {{q8}} updated with vacancy announcements submitted by member companies and approved by the editorial committee.

explanation.summary_zh: regularly 是副詞，修飾網站更新的頻率。
explanation.reasoning_zh: is updated 是被動動詞片語，空格用來說明更新如何進行。regularly 表示定期地，能修飾 updated；其他選項的詞性與此處的修飾功能不合。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: regularly 是副詞，regularly updated 表示網站會定期更新職缺公告。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: regular 是形容詞，無法在 is 和 updated 之間表達更新的頻率。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: regularity 是名詞，表示規律性，不能直接放入此處修飾被動動詞。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: regularize 是動詞，表示使制度化或使合乎規定，不適合此處已完整的被動結構。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 空格若修飾動作的頻率，留意副詞形式及整個動詞片語。

questions.prompt: The newspaper checks reporters' investments for potential {{q9}} of interest between personal financial gain and the duty to report impartially.

explanation.summary_zh: conflicts of interest 指個人財務利益與公正報導職責之間的利益衝突。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 報導者的投資可能使個人財務利益與公正報導的職責互相衝突。conflicts of interest 是描述這種關係的搭配，並與後方 between 引出的兩方相接。其餘片語雖都存在，卻分別指關注事項、利益揭露聲明或參與意向，不能表達本句的利益對立關係。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: matters of interest 指值得關注或感興趣的事項，不是財務利益與報導職責之間的衝突關係。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: declarations of interest 指揭露相關利益的聲明；投資與公正職責之間可能產生的是衝突，不是聲明。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: expressions of interest 可指表達參與或承接工作等意願，並非個人財務利益與公正報導之間的對立。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: conflicts of interest 表示利益衝突，正確連結個人財務收益與必須公正報導的職責。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 完整搭配都可能成立時，要比較各片語實際描述的是事項、聲明、意向，還是利益衝突。

questions.prompt: The retirement adviser with {{q10}} employees may discuss pension contributions is available for individual appointments every Thursday afternoon.

explanation.summary_zh: whom 是前置介系詞 with 的受詞，指前面的退休金顧問。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 關係子句來自 employees may discuss pension contributions with the retirement adviser。with 移到關係子句開頭後，其後用受格 whom 指人，形成 with whom employees may discuss，其中 employees 是關係子句的主詞，may discuss 是其動詞。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: whose 必須限定其後的名詞。若填入 whose，with whose employees 會把 employees 併入介系詞片語，may discuss 便缺少主詞，句子不成立。whose 並非不能接在介系詞後（如其他句構中的 with whose help），而是本句的結構容不下它。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: who 常作關係子句的主詞，但此處 employees 才是主詞；介系詞 with 直接置於關係代名詞前時，須用受格 whom。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: whom 是受格關係代名詞，能接在 with 後並指稱提供諮詢的 adviser，其後 employees may discuss 是完整的子句主幹。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: which 通常指物，此處 adviser 是可供員工預約諮詢的人，應使用指人的 whom。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 遇到介系詞前置的關係子句，可把介系詞連同先行詞一起放回子句還原，如 employees may discuss pension contributions with the retirement adviser；先行詞 adviser 是 with 的受詞且指人，因此用 whom，同時確認子句仍保有自己的主詞 employees。

questions.prompt: Trade-fair staff will {{q11}} each visitor's badge with an electronic reader to confirm that the registration code is valid.

explanation.summary_zh: scan 表示掃描，符合使用電子讀取器確認識別證代碼的動作。
explanation.reasoning_zh: with an electronic reader 指出所用工具，to confirm that the registration code is valid 說明目的。工作人員要讀取識別證上的代碼，因此應選 scan。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: scan 表示以讀取器掃描識別證，能讀取代碼並確認登錄資料是否有效。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: assign 表示分配，例如分派攤位；它不是以讀取器讀取現有識別證的動作。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: print 表示列印，通常需要印表機；此處工具是用來讀取代碼的電子讀取器。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: attach 表示附上或固定；把識別證固定在某處並不能以題述方式讀取及確認代碼。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 動詞選擇可同時利用工具與目的，確認實際要進行的動作。

questions.prompt: Customers requesting a refund must provide {{q12}} of purchase, such as a dated receipt, at the returns counter.

explanation.summary_zh: proof of purchase 是購買證明，附日期的收據就是其中一種。
explanation.reasoning_zh: provide 後面需要受詞，of purchase 說明證明的內容。proof 是名詞，可組成 proof of purchase；後面的 such as a dated receipt 提供購買證明的具體例子。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: prove 是動詞，表示證明，不能直接作 provide 在此所需的名詞受詞。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: proof 是名詞，proof of purchase 表示購買證明，符合退貨櫃檯要求提供收據的情境。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: proven 是過去分詞或形容詞，表示已獲證實的，不能單獨組成此處的購買證明名詞片語。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: provably 是副詞，表示可證明地，無法作 provide 的受詞。

explanation.takeaway_zh: provide 後需要名詞受詞，並與 of purchase 組成名詞片語，因此選名詞 proof；後方 a dated receipt 的例子只能確認語意是購買證明，無法單獨區分這些同字根的選項。

questions.prompt: Because its cost estimate is still incomplete, the library board has {{q13}} a vote on longer opening hours until September.

explanation.summary_zh: put off a vote until September 表示把表決延到九月。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 成本估算尚未完成，董事會因此把延長開館時間的表決延後。put off 可表示延期，與 until September 配合，指出延後到哪個時間再進行。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: put off 表示延後，符合估算未完成而將表決延至九月的情境。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: carried out 表示執行或完成；has carried out a vote 不能表達把一次表決留到未來九月再進行。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: brought forward 表示提前安排，與此處因估算不完整而等待至九月的方向相反。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: gone over 表示仔細檢視，並非延期；has gone over a vote until September 也無法自然表達此處的未來安排。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 區分片語動詞時，留意事件是延後、提前、執行還是檢視。

questions.prompt: Each of the community garden's twenty plots {{q14}} a numbered water meter, so gardeners can track their own usage.

explanation.summary_zh: 主詞核心是 Each，因此用第三人稱單數 has。
explanation.reasoning_zh: Each of the community garden's twenty plots 逐一指每塊菜圃，文法上的主詞核心為 Each，後方 twenty plots 不改變其單數性。has 表示每塊菜圃都配有水表。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: have 在此不與第三人稱單數主詞 Each 一致；不能因旁邊出現 twenty plots 就選 have。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: are having 的 are 不與主詞 Each 一致，且這裡描述的是配有水表的狀態。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: were having 的 were 不與此處主詞 Each 一致，也無法表達句中目前配有水表的狀態。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: has 與主詞 Each 一致，表示二十塊菜圃中的每一塊都配有編號水表。

explanation.takeaway_zh: each of + 複數名詞作主詞時，主詞核心是 each，動詞用單數；但 some/most/all of 等則要看 of 後的名詞決定單複數。

questions.prompt: The jar's {{q15}} lid lets customers read the small print on the label inside without opening the package or removing its safety seal.

explanation.summary_zh: transparent 表示透明的，能讓顧客隔著蓋子讀清內部標籤的小字。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 題目說顧客不必開封，就能隔著蓋子讀取內部標籤的小字，因此需要能清楚透視的材質。transparent 表示透明的，與其他阻擋或散射光線的材質不同。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: opaque 表示不透明的，會遮擋視線，無法隔著蓋子讀取裡面的標籤。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: transparent 表示透明的，符合不開封就能讀清內部標籤小字的功能。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: frosted 表示磨砂的，表面會使透視影像模糊，不符合清楚讀取內部小字的要求。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: translucent 表示半透明的，雖可透光，卻無法像透明材質一樣清楚呈現後方標籤的小字。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 選形容詞時，將後文描述的具體功能對應到正確性質。

questions.prompt: After several growers requested more time to prepare their paperwork, the farmers market granted a one-week {{q16}} of the application deadline.

explanation.summary_zh: extension of the deadline 表示延長截止期限，讓申請者多一週準備。
explanation.reasoning_zh: growers 要求更多準備文件的時間，而市場同意給予一週。grant an extension of a deadline 表示准予延長期限，正確連結申請者的要求與市場的處理方式。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: estimate 表示估計，但一週的估計不是准予更多申請時間的做法。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: interval 表示兩個時間點或事件之間的間隔，不能以 grant an interval of the deadline 表達延長期限。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: extension 表示延長，a one-week extension of the application deadline 即把申請期限延長一週。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: schedule 表示時程表，grant a one-week schedule of the deadline 不是延長截止日的說法。

explanation.takeaway_zh: deadline 搭配 extension 時，指截止期限向後延長。

questions.prompt: The procedures {{q17}} during staff training are summarized on a reference card that employees can keep beside their workstations.

explanation.summary_zh: demonstrated 是過去分詞，表示訓練中被示範的程序。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 主句動詞是 are summarized。空格到 during staff training 修飾 procedures，可理解為 procedures that were demonstrated during staff training；程序是示範的內容，因此用過去分詞。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: demonstration 是名詞，不能在此形成修飾 procedures、表示程序曾被示範的片語。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: demonstrate 是原形動詞，無法直接接在 procedures 後構成此處需要的修飾結構。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: demonstrating 是現在分詞，會使 procedures 成為進行示範的一方，與訓練中被示範的程序不符。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: demonstrated 是過去分詞，正確表示程序是訓練時被示範的內容。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 判斷名詞後的分詞時，先確認該名詞是動作執行者還是承受者。

questions.prompt: {{q18}} the newspaper editor's explicit limit of 500 words, the reporter submitted an article containing more than 1,000 words.

explanation.summary_zh: Despite 接名詞片語，表示雖有五百字上限，文章仍超過一千字。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 空格後是以 limit 為核心的名詞片語 the newspaper editor's explicit limit of 500 words。Despite 和 Because of 都能接名詞片語，但此句對比五百字上限與超過一千字的成稿，呈現違反預期的讓步關係，因此選 Despite。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: Despite 可接這個名詞片語，表示儘管有明確字數上限，記者仍提交超標文章，語法與讓步關係都符合。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: Although 需要引導子句；空格後到逗號前只有名詞片語，沒有完整子句的謂語。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: Even though 也需引導子句，不能直接接此處以 limit 為核心的名詞片語。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: Because of 在語法上可接名詞片語，但會將五百字上限當成提交超過一千字文章的原因；本句呈現的是規定與結果相反的讓步關係。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 先檢查後方是名詞片語或子句，再判斷前後內容呈現因果還是讓步關係。

questions.prompt: The bookshop placed a large {{q19}} for the popular cookbook after its entire first shipment sold out in one afternoon.

explanation.summary_zh: place an order 是下訂單，書店售罄後因此再次訂購。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 第一批到貨的食譜書一下午就售罄，所以書店接著大量訂貨。place an order for a product 是訂購商品的搭配，這裡的 large 表示訂單規模大。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: stock 指庫存，不能以 placed a large stock for the cookbook 表示向供應商下單。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: supply 指供應量或存量，但 place a supply 不是此處採購訂貨的搭配。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: order 指訂單，placed a large order for the cookbook 表示大量訂購這本食譜書。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: inventory 指存貨或存貨清單，並非書店售罄後向供應商發出的訂單。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 區分訂購行為與現有存貨，並記住 place an order 的搭配。

questions.prompt: The recruitment agency's client offers a {{q20}} salary to attract experienced technicians who are considering positions with several employers.

explanation.summary_zh: competitive 是形容詞，competitive salary 指具競爭力的薪資。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 空格位於 a 與 salary 之間，需要描述薪資性質。後文說求職者正考慮多家雇主，因此 competitive salary 表示足以與其他雇主競爭、吸引人才的薪資。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: competition 是名詞，指競爭或競賽；competition salary 不是此處表達薪資具吸引力的搭配。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: competitive 是形容詞，能修飾 salary，表示這份薪資在人才市場上具有競爭力。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: competitively 是副詞，不能在此直接放在冠詞與 salary 之間修飾這個名詞。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: compete 是動詞，表示競爭，無法直接作此處描述 salary 性質的修飾語。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 判斷字族題時，結合修飾位置與整個商務搭配的意思。

questions.prompt: The bicycle repair shop's {{q21}} rate for wheel alignment is $20 per wheel, regardless of how long the work takes.

explanation.summary_zh: flat rate 表示固定費率，每個車輪收二十美元，不隨工時改變。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 題目把計價單位定為每個車輪，並明說不論工作耗時多久，費率都是二十美元。flat rate 表示按約定單位收取固定金額；其餘三項則分別以小時、日或週作為計價時間單位。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: flat rate 是固定費率，符合每輪二十美元且不依工時長短調整的收費方式。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: hourly rate 是按小時計算的費率，但本句按每個車輪計價，並明說不隨耗時改變。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: daily rate 是按日計算的費率，與這裡按車輪數而非工作天數計價的方式不合。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: weekly rate 是按週計算的費率，不能表達本句不論耗時多久都按每輪收費的固定方式。

explanation.takeaway_zh: flat rate 指按約定單位收取固定金額；辨認計價方式時，要留意按件或按時間收費。

questions.prompt: Before selecting a thicker carton, the packaging team will {{q22}} its improved durability against the additional time needed for assembly.

explanation.summary_zh: weigh A against B 表示權衡耐用度提升與額外組裝時間。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 較厚紙箱的優點是更耐用，代價是組裝耗時增加。句子結構為 ___ its improved durability against the additional time needed for assembly，要把一項好處與一項代價放在一起比較。weigh one factor against another 表示比較優缺點或得失，正好描述團隊在選擇紙箱前的權衡。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: forecast 表示預測未來情況；forecast durability against assembly time 不是此處比較優點與代價的搭配。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: distribute 表示分發或分配，不能以 distribute durability against time 表示權衡兩個因素。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: compile 表示彙整或編製資料。團隊固然可以彙整與耐用度相關的資料，但本句的 improved durability 是用來與 the additional time needed for assembly 比較的好處，任務是選擇紙箱前的取捨，而不是蒐集資料。compile its improved durability against the additional time 無法表達這種得失權衡，weigh X against Y 才是此處所需的框架。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: weigh 與 against 搭配，表示將耐用度的提升和增加的組裝時間放在一起權衡。

explanation.takeaway_zh: weigh A against B 可表達決策時比較某項好處與相應代價。

questions.prompt: Vendors seeking a listing in the printed farmers market directory must submit a completed application {{q23}} June 18.

explanation.summary_zh: by June 18 為提交申請設定最晚期限，以便列入印製的市場廠商名錄。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 主句要求想列入名錄的廠商完成 submit a completed application 這項送件動作，June 18 則標示完成的最後期限。by 接指定日期可表達最晚於該日完成，符合句中為提交申請設定截止日的要求。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: until June 18 會將六月十八日作為某項行為持續的終點；此處要求交妥一份申請，不是要求送件動作持續到那天。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: by June 18 表示最晚在六月十八日完成提交，能為這項送件任務設定截止日。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: since June 18 把該日當作持續期間的起點；本句需要的是完成申請的最後期限，而非從該日起的持續情況。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: within 在這類期限表達中可接 three days 等期間；within June 18 不是此處以指定日期表示送件截止日的自然搭配。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 時間介系詞要分清完成期限、持續終點與起點；by 加日期可設定任務的最晚完成時間。

questions.prompt: Members of the professional association who are interested in {{q24}} junior colleagues should register for its new mentoring program.

explanation.summary_zh: interested in advising 表示有興趣指導資淺同事。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 這裡的 in 是 interested in 片語中的介系詞。後方要接指導同事這項活動，因此用動名詞 advising，並以 junior colleagues 作它的受詞。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: advise 是動詞原形，不能直接接在此處的介系詞 in 後形成活動名詞片語。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: to advise 是不定詞，不能放在已出現的 interested in 後面。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: advising 是動名詞，advising junior colleagues 表示指導資淺同事這項活動。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: advised 是過去式或過去分詞，無法在 in 後接 junior colleagues 構成所需的活動片語。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 遇到 interested in 等含介系詞的片語，留意後接動名詞的結構。

questions.prompt: The library has already received the grant for a new archive scanner; {{q25}}, the purchase remains on hold because no suitable model is available.

explanation.summary_zh: nevertheless 表示儘管資金已到位，採購仍因沒有合適機型而暫停。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前句表示補助款已取得，通常使購買具備資金條件；後句卻說購買仍擱置，並提出機型不合適的另一項障礙。nevertheless 正確標示這個轉折關係。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: nevertheless 表示儘管如此，符合已取得補助卻仍無法完成採購的對比。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: consequently 表示因此，但資金到位並非採購暫停的原因；句中明說原因是沒有合適機型。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: for example 用於舉例，採購暫停不是已取得補助款的例子。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: likewise 表示同樣地，兩句並非兩個相似的進展，而是資金到位與採購仍受阻的轉折。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 連接副詞要反映前後命題的關係，不能只看後句本身是否通順。

questions.prompt: The art-supply store {{q26}} the new pigment range for only six months when its manufacturer announced that production would end.

explanation.summary_zh: had been selling 表示在過去宣布停產之前，店家已持續銷售六個月。
explanation.reasoning_zh: announced 是過去發生的事件，for only six months 描述截至那個宣布時點已持續的銷售期間。過去完成進行式 had been selling 能連結較早開始的活動與後來的過去事件。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: has been selling 以現在為參照，與此處由過去 announced 界定的六個月期間不合。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: had been selling 以製造商宣布停產的過去時點為參照，表示在那之前已持續銷售六個月。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: will be selling 表示未來某時正在銷售，與句中已發生的宣布及之前的銷售期間不符。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: is selling 表示目前正在銷售，無法在此結構中表達截至過去宣布時點的六個月歷程。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 若持續期間的終點是另一個過去事件，可考慮過去完成進行式。

questions.prompt: For the same 400-word letter, this translation service's quote was {{q27}} than the amount quoted by its nearest competitor.

explanation.summary_zh: lower 與 than 搭配，比較兩家服務對同一封信的報價。
explanation.reasoning_zh: the same 400-word letter 確保比較的是同一份文件，than 引出競爭者的報價。此處需要 low 的比較級 lower，表示這家服務的報價較低。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: low 是原級形容詞，不能在此直接接 than 形成兩個金額高低的比較。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: lowest 是最高級，無法配合此處 than 引出的兩方比較結構。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: lowering 是分詞，描述降低的動作，並不是可接 than 比較兩個報價的形容詞形式。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: lower 是比較級，lower than the amount quoted 表示比另一家報出的金額低。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 先確認比較對象一致，再依 than 等結構線索選比較級。

questions.prompt: Because the rehearsal schedule is very tight, the director has allowed {{q28}} extra time for costume changes between scenes.

explanation.summary_zh: little 修飾不可數的 time，表示換裝可多用的時間很少。
explanation.reasoning_zh: time 在這裡指可用時間的總量，為不可數名詞，因此 little 與 much 在詞性和可數性上都能修飾它。但 because 把排練時程非常緊湊作為分配時間的原因，應選表示額外時間很少的 little，而非表示大量的 much。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: few 後接複數可數名詞；此處 time 指時間總量，並非複數的次數。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: much 可修飾不可數的 time，語法上能代入；但它表示大量額外時間，不符合本句以時程非常緊湊為原因所表達的少量時間。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: little 可修飾不可數名詞，表示額外時間很少，符合時程緊湊的原因。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: many 用於複數可數名詞，無法修飾本句表示時間量的 time。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 數量詞先分可數與不可數，再依時程緊湊等語意線索判斷應表達量多還是量少。

questions.prompt: The landscape designer has {{q29}} arranged the seating so that every bench has a clear view of the central fountain.

explanation.summary_zh: strategically 是副詞，說明座椅經過有目的的安排。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 空格修飾 arranged the seating 這個安排動作，後文說每張長椅都能看清中央噴泉，說明擺設經過規劃。strategically 表示有策略地、經過周密安排地。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: strategically 是副詞，可修飾 arranged，表示為了良好視野而有目的地安排座椅。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: strategic 是形容詞，不能放在 has 與 arranged 之間修飾這個動作。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: strategy 是名詞，指策略，不能在 has arranged 這個動詞片語中作此處所需的方式修飾語。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: strategist 是名詞，指策略規劃者，並非表示安排方式的副詞。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 分析空格修飾的是人、物還是動作，有助於選出正確詞性。

questions.prompt: Exhibitors should resize their product photographs and save {{q30}} as JPEG files before uploading the images to the trade-fair catalog.

explanation.summary_zh: them 是 save 的受詞，代指前面的 product photographs。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 參展商先調整商品照片尺寸，再將這些照片存成 JPEG 檔。save 後需要受詞，them 是複數受格代名詞，既符合句法，也能正確指回 product photographs。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: their 是所有格限定詞，後面需要名詞，不能單獨作此處 save 的受詞。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: them 是複數受格代名詞，指商品照片，符合存成 JPEG 檔及上傳影像的步驟。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: themselves 是反身代名詞，會指回主詞 Exhibitors；要存成影像檔的是照片，而非參展商本人。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: they 是主格代名詞，不能直接作動詞 save 在此所需的受詞。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 代名詞題要同時檢查句法格位，以及它實際指回哪個名詞。

content.title: Missing Upholstery Tool
content.scenario_summary: Merrow Equipment Rentals sends an internal memo after a carpet cleaner reaches Alden Offices without its upholstery tool. Desk staff are told to look on the demonstration bench or use a replacement from stock. Because the office manager cannot collect the tool, the shop will deliver it on its driver's existing route. Desk staff give the driver two handover forms; he obtains a signature on one, returns it to the rental desk, and leaves the unsigned copy with the customer as a record of the tool received.

blocks.text: MERROW EQUIPMENT RENTALS
To: Rental Desk Staff
From: Tessa Venn, Operations Supervisor
Date: May 12
Subject: Missing upholstery tool for rental C218

The carpet cleaner delivered to Alden Offices yesterday arrived without its upholstery tool. The tool is believed {{q1}} on our demonstration bench after yesterday morning's customer trial. Check there first; if it is not there, use a replacement from stock.
Alden's office manager cannot leave work to collect it and has asked us to bring it to her building. Record her request for {{q2}} in the rental file.
Our driver has space on this afternoon's route. {{q3}}, we can send the tool without hiring a courier.
Give the driver two copies of the handover form. {{q4}} The driver will return the signed copy to the rental desk; the customer will keep the unsigned copy as a record of the tool received.

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q1}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 工具是被留在展示工作檯上的物品，因此採用完成式被動不定詞。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 此句採用「主詞＋is believed＋不定詞」的轉述結構。工具是 leave 這個動作的承受者，而被留下的時間在昨日的試用之後、早於現在的判斷，因此 to have been left 符合句法與時間關係。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: to have left 是主動形式，會把工具當成離開或留下某物的動作主體；本句要表達工具被人留在工作檯上，因此須用被動形式。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: having been left 雖能表達已被留下，但它是分詞形式，無法直接接入此處「The tool is believed＋不定詞」的句型。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: to have been left 是完成式被動不定詞，可接在 is believed 後，表示工具先前被留在展示工作檯上。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: having left 是主動分詞形式，既不符合此處 is believed 後的不定詞結構，也未表達工具被留下的意思。

evidence.quote: The tool is believed {{q1}} on our demonstration bench after yesterday morning's customer trial.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 辨識轉述句後的不定詞結構，再依主詞與動作的關係選擇主動或被動形式。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q2}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 經理請店家把工具送到大樓，因此應記錄她要求配送。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 單看「記錄她要求的服務」，四個名詞都能接在 request for 後。前一句指出經理無法離開工作地點領取工具，並要求店家送到她的大樓，這項要求就是 delivery。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: inspection 是檢查；經理的要求是將工具送到大樓，文中沒有要求進行檢查。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: delivery 是配送，準確對應前句 bring it to her building，也解決經理無法親自領取的問題。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: collection 是領取或收取物品；本段要求的移動方向是店家把工具送往經理的大樓，並非請她前來領取。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: demonstration 是示範；首段雖提到先前的試用，經理此處要求的是送來缺少的工具，並未要求示範。

evidence.quote: Alden's office manager cannot leave work to collect it and has asked us to bring it to her building.
Record her request for {{q2}} in the rental file.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 服務類名詞要依前文描述的具體要求判斷，不能只看空格附近的搭配。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q3}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 司機下午的路線還有空間，因此店家不必另請快遞。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前一句說明自家司機下午的路線還有空間，後一句說因此可以直接運送工具、不必另請快遞。兩句形成原因與結果的關係，Consequently 能清楚連結這項安排及其結果。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: Otherwise 表示否則或在另一種情況下；本段是在說明司機有空間所帶來的結果，並非沒有空間時的替代情況。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: Nevertheless 表示儘管如此，需要前後有讓步或反差；司機有空間與不用另請快遞是相互支持的資訊。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: Conversely 用來引出相反或反向的關係；後句沒有反轉前句，而是提出前句條件所促成的安排。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: Consequently 表示因此，將司機尚有空間這個原因，連接到可以免請快遞、直接送工具的結果。

evidence.quote: Our driver has space on this afternoon's route. {{q3}}, we can send the tool without hiring a courier.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 先確認相鄰句子的因果、讓步或反向關係，再選擇符合該關係的連接詞。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q4}}.

options.label: A
options.text: He should have the customer sign one copy and leave the other unsigned.

options.label: B
options.text: He should have the customer sign both copies and return both to us.

options.label: C
options.text: He should have the customer keep both copies without signing either one.

options.label: D
options.text: He should have the customer sign both copies and keep one for her records.

explanation.summary_zh: 後文分別提到已簽名與未簽名的副本，因此應只簽其中一份。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 櫃檯人員先把兩份交接表單交給司機；後文說司機將已簽名的一份帶回櫃檯，顧客保留未簽名的一份作為收到工具的紀錄。因此空格應說明由司機請顧客只簽一份，另一份不簽。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 司機請顧客只簽其中一份，就會留下已簽名與未簽名各一份，能完整銜接後句各自的去向。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 兩份都簽且都交還店家，既沒有未簽名的副本，也沒有留給顧客的副本，與後句兩項安排衝突。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 司機若讓顧客保留兩份且都不簽名，就無法取得後句要求帶回櫃檯的已簽名副本。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 兩份都簽名，雖然能讓顧客保留一份，卻不會有後句指定由她保留的未簽名副本。

evidence.quote: Give the driver two copies of the handover form.
The driver will return the signed copy to the rental desk; the customer will keep the unsigned copy as a record of the tool received.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 整句填空可追蹤前後文中物件的數量、狀態與去向，檢查流程是否一致。

content.title: Correction to a Subscription Storage Allowance
content.scenario_summary: Cedar Ledger corrects an invalid subscription letter that described its Standard plan's storage as 10 GB per user rather than 10 GB for the entire account. The customer is asked to forward the correction to two account administrators. Existing files use only 6 GB, so no removal is needed. The corrected letter establishes the limit, while an enclosed usage report records only space used on a particular date.

blocks.text: Dear Ms. Tran,

Please discard our subscription letter of May 8; it is no longer valid. This letter {{q1}} it in full. Your Cedar Ledger Standard subscription includes 10 GB for the entire account, rather than 10 GB per user as previously stated.
Our billing team has received this correction, but your account administrators, Mr. Ellis and Ms. Duarte, have not. Both need a copy before approving storage requests. Please forward it to {{q2}}.
The files in your account currently use 6 GB. {{q3}} You can therefore keep all your existing files on Standard.
Please keep this letter and the enclosed May usage report. You can find the corrected storage allowance in {{q4}}; the latter shows only the space used as of May 1.

Yours sincerely,
Iona Moss
Customer Accounts
Cedar Ledger

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q1}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 舊函已失效且應丟棄，新函是全面取代舊函。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前一句明確要求丟棄舊函，並說舊函已不再有效。因此新函與舊函的關係是全面取代，而非補充或恢復其效力。supersedes 表示取代先前的文件、規則或安排，符合此處的更正通知。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: supplements 表示補充；若新函只是補充，舊函仍會作為原有資訊的基礎，與前句要求丟棄已失效舊函的指示不符。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: supersedes 表示取代並使原有版本不再適用，準確銜接舊函已失效以及新函全面取代它的資訊。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: reinstates 表示恢復原有狀態或效力；本段撤除的是舊函效力，並沒有讓舊函重新生效。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: confirms 表示確認或證實；原函的錯誤資訊已被撤銷，新函並非確認原函全部內容，而是取代它。

evidence.quote: Please discard our subscription letter of May 8; it is no longer valid.
This letter {{q1}} it in full.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 遇到文件效力相關字彙，先判斷新舊版本是取代、補充，還是恢復效力。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q2}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 兩位具名管理員都需要收到更正資訊，因此應使用指代兩人的 them。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前文說帳務團隊已收到更正資訊，但 Ellis 先生與 Duarte 女士尚未收到，而且兩人都需要一份副本。him 與 her 各指其中一人，us 則指寄件者所屬的一方；them 才能同時指代這兩位管理員，符合轉寄目的。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: him 可在此指 Ellis 先生，放在 to 後也合乎文法，但只涵蓋一位管理員，未滿足兩人都需收到副本的要求。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: us 指寄件者所屬的 Cedar Ledger 一方；帳務團隊已收到資訊，這個選項無法指代尚未收到的兩位客戶端管理員。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: her 可在此指 Duarte 女士，放在 to 後也合乎文法，但會漏掉同樣需要副本的 Ellis 先生。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: them 是受格代名詞，放在 to 後同時指代 Ellis 先生與 Duarte 女士，符合前文 Both need a copy 的要求。

evidence.quote: Our billing team has received this correction, but your account administrators, Mr. Ellis and Ms. Duarte, have not.
Both need a copy before approving storage requests. Please forward it to {{q2}}.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 代名詞選項即使都合乎句法，仍須核對所指人物與前文要求涵蓋的人數。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q3}}.

options.label: A
options.text: You still have 4 GB available for additional files.

options.label: B
options.text: You need to remove 4 GB before adding more files.

options.label: C
options.text: You have no space left for any additional files.

options.label: D
options.text: You have 10 GB available for additional files.

explanation.summary_zh: 帳戶總額度為 10 GB，目前使用 6 GB，因此仍有 4 GB 可用。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前文將整個帳戶的額度更正為 10 GB，此處指出現有檔案使用 6 GB，兩者相減可知仍剩 4 GB。這項資訊也能支持後句的結論：現有檔案可以全部留在 Standard 方案中。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 10 GB 減去已使用的 6 GB，確實還有 4 GB 可以存放新增檔案，並能銜接後句保留現有檔案的結論。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 現有使用量未超過 10 GB，且還有 4 GB 空間，因此並不需要先移除 4 GB 才能加入任何新檔案。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 目前只用了 6 GB，並未用滿 10 GB；說完全沒有空間存放新增檔案，與尚餘 4 GB 的數值不符。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 10 GB 是帳戶的總額度，並非剩餘空間；扣除已使用的 6 GB 後，可供新增檔案使用的是 4 GB。

evidence.quote: Your Cedar Ledger Standard subscription includes 10 GB for the entire account, rather than 10 GB per user as previously stated.
The files in your account currently use 6 GB.
You can therefore keep all your existing files on Standard.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 整句填空可先區分總額度、已用量與剩餘量，再核對插入句能否支持後文結論。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q4}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 兩份文件中先提到的是本函，正確的總額度應查本函。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前一句依序列出本函與隨附的五月使用量報告。本函已說明更正後的總額度，報告則僅列出五月一日當時的使用量。因此應選 the former 指兩者中的前者，也就是本函。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: the latter 指兩者中的後者，即五月使用量報告；後半句已說該報告只顯示當時使用的空間，沒有提供更正後的額度。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: neither document 表示兩份文件都找不到，但本函已明確寫出整個帳戶的正確額度為 10 GB。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: the former 指前一句先提到的 this letter；本函確實提供更正後的總儲存額度。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: either document 表示任一份都能查到，但使用量報告只有已用空間的數據，不能據此當作更正後的總額度。

evidence.quote: Your Cedar Ledger Standard subscription includes 10 GB for the entire account, rather than 10 GB per user as previously stated.
Please keep this letter and the enclosed May usage report.
You can find the corrected storage allowance in {{q4}}; the latter shows only the space used as of May 1.

explanation.takeaway_zh: former 與 latter 要依前句出現順序還原指涉，並核對兩個對象各自提供的資訊。

content.title: Replacement Prototype for Customer Interviews
content.scenario_summary: Wren Housewares is preparing another round of customer interviews comparing its standard desk organizer with a wider prototype. The prototype was accidentally damaged after the previous round. Research assistants must request the same version using a photograph of its base label. The design studio will collect the damaged prototype after delivering the replacement. Because the replacement arrives after the original interview date, all next-round interviews move to a later date with their duration unchanged.

blocks.text: WREN HOUSEWARES
To: Customer Research Assistants
From: Naomi Bell, Research Coordinator
Date: June 14
Subject: Replacement for damaged prototype

In last week's interviews, customers compared our standard desk organizer with a wider prototype on loan from the design studio. The studio also offers narrow and extra-wide prototypes. A visitor damaged the borrowed sample after the final session. The replacement must match {{q1}}.

The study's photo folder contains front views and base-label photographs of the standard organizer and the wider prototype. {{q2}} The version code needed by the design studio is printed only on the base label.
The damaged prototype will {{q3}} by the studio after the replacement arrives.

The next round will again compare the standard organizer with the wider prototype. The replacement is due on June 20, after the original interview date of June 18. The interviews will now take place on June 21 and will still last 30 minutes each. Tell participants their interviews have been {{q4}}.

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q1}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 損壞的是借入的較寬原型，替換品必須匹配這個版本。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 首句說比較的是標準款與向設計工作室借來的較寬原型，接著另外介紹工作室也提供窄版與加寬版。受損的 borrowed sample 回指借來的較寬原型，因此替換品應匹配 the version we borrowed，而不是另外兩款原型或標準款。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: the version we borrowed 指首句向工作室借入的較寬原型，也就是後文被損壞的 borrowed sample，符合此次替換對象。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 窄版是工作室另外提供的原型款式，並非本次借來且受損的較寬原型；選它會改變下一輪比較的產品版本。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 加寬版同樣是工作室另有提供的款式，不是本次借入的較寬原型；下一輪明確仍要比較原來的標準款與較寬原型。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 標準款是比較中的另一個產品，並非借自工作室的受損樣品；替換標準款無法取得所需的較寬原型替換品。

evidence.quote: In last week's interviews, customers compared our standard desk organizer with a wider prototype on loan from the design studio.
The studio also offers narrow and extra-wide prototypes.
A visitor damaged the borrowed sample after the final session. The replacement must match {{q1}}.
The next round will again compare the standard organizer with the wider prototype.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 多個款式同時出現時，追蹤借用、損壞與替換的對應關係，不要只選最近提到的款式。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q2}}.

options.label: A
options.text: Attach a front-view photograph of the wider prototype to the replacement request.

options.label: B
options.text: Attach a base-label photograph of the standard organizer to the replacement request.

options.label: C
options.text: Attach a front-view photograph of the standard organizer to the replacement request.

options.label: D
options.text: Attach a base-label photograph of the wider prototype to the replacement request.

explanation.summary_zh: 申請替換較寬原型時，應附上能顯示其版本代碼的底部標籤照片。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前段確定需要替換較寬原型，本段則說資料夾中有兩款產品的正面與底部標籤照片。後句指出設計工作室需要版本代碼，而且代碼只印在底部標籤上，因此附件必須同時選對款式與照片部位。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 款式雖然是需要替換的較寬原型，但正面照片不會顯示只印在底部標籤上的版本代碼。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 底部標籤照片能顯示代碼，但這張屬於標準款，無法提供需要替換的較寬原型之正確版本資訊。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 這張照片既選成標準款，又只顯示正面，款式與取得版本代碼所需的部位都不符合要求。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 較寬原型是受損物件，其底部標籤又包含工作室需要的版本代碼，因此同時滿足款式與資訊要求。

evidence.quote: In last week's interviews, customers compared our standard desk organizer with a wider prototype on loan from the design studio.
A visitor damaged the borrowed sample after the final session.
The study's photo folder contains front views and base-label photographs of the standard organizer and the wider prototype.
The version code needed by the design studio is printed only on the base label.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 比較接近的整句選項時，可分別核對對象與所需資訊的位置，避免只符合其中一項。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q3}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 損壞原型是被工作室收走的物品，應使用未來式被動語態。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 主詞 The damaged prototype 是 collect 的承受者，by the studio 則交代收取者。此處 will 後接 be collected，構成「will be＋過去分詞」，表示替換品到達後，損壞原型將由工作室收走。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: will collect 是主動形式，會把損壞原型當成收取者，與工作室來收走原型的意思不符。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: will be collected 是未來式被動語態，表示損壞原型將被工作室收走，符合主詞與動作的關係。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: will have collected 是未來完成式主動形式，未表達原型被收走，也無法把 by the studio 當成此主動動作的執行者。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: will be collecting 是未來進行式主動形式，表示主詞將在收取物品，並非原型由工作室收走。

evidence.quote: The damaged prototype will {{q3}} by the studio after the replacement arrives.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 判斷主詞是執行動作還是承受動作，再決定 will 後應接主動或被動形式。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q4}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 訪談從六月十八日移到六月二十一日，長度不變，因此是延期。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 訪談必須使用兩款樣品，但替換品六月二十日才到，比原訂六月十八日晚。備忘錄已將訪談改到六月二十一日，並說每場仍為三十分鐘。因此改變的是日期往後移，不是取消或調整長度，應用 postponed。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: shortened 表示縮短；文中明確說每場三十分鐘的長度不變，因此沒有縮短訪談。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: cancelled 表示取消，但文中已指定訪談仍會在六月二十一日進行，並沒有取消這些訪談。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: postponed 表示延期；原訂六月十八日的訪談改在六月二十一日進行，正是將日期往後移。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: extended 表示延長；此處訪談長度維持三十分鐘，日期較晚不代表每場訪談的時間被延長。

evidence.quote: The next round will again compare the standard organizer with the wider prototype.
The replacement is due on June 20, after the original interview date of June 18.
The interviews will now take place on June 21 and will still last 30 minutes each.
Tell participants their interviews have been {{q4}}.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 區分日期往後移、活動取消與時長改變，依前文實際變動選擇動詞。

content.title: ShiftFit Workshops
content.scenario_summary: Brindle Learning advertises its new on-site customer-service training package. A team of up to twelve can attend together or split between two identical sessions, receiving the same content either way. The trainer turns a customer question supplied by the client into a two-employee role-play; the pair exchanges customer and employee roles to try different replies. Handouts provide space for notes. The fixed $240 price covers either format, with $60 paid at booking and the balance due when training is complete.

blocks.text: TRAIN YOUR TEAM, BETWEEN SHIFTS
New from Brindle Learning: ShiftFit Workshops

Practical customer-service training, delivered at your workplace. Choose one 45-minute session for up to twelve staff, or split the same team between two identical sessions. {{q1}}, everyone receives the same training.
Send us a recurring customer question when you book. {{q2}} The pair switches customer and employee roles halfway through, giving both a chance to test different replies.
Handouts {{q3}} to each participant, with space for notes on useful replies.
The $240 package covers either format, with no additional charges. Pay $60 at booking; this payment counts toward the package price. The {{q4}} is due after your training is complete.
Request a date at brindlelearning.example/shiftfit.

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q1}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 不論全體一起上課或拆成兩組，員工都會接受相同訓練。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前一句提供兩種安排：全隊參加一場，或分組參加內容相同的兩場。後一句說每個人接受的訓練相同，是涵蓋兩種安排的共同結果，因此選 Either way，表示無論採取哪一種方式。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: By contrast 用來引出對比，但後句強調兩種安排的訓練內容相同，並非提出相反情況。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: Either way 表示無論採取前述哪種方式，都會得到後面所述的結果，符合兩種分組安排提供相同訓練的資訊。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: Otherwise 會引出不採取前述安排時的另一種情況；後句則是在說明前述兩種安排都適用的結果。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: Instead 表示改採另一種做法，但接受相同訓練不是用來取代兩種分組安排的第三種做法。

evidence.quote: Choose one 45-minute session for up to twelve staff, or split the same team between two identical sessions.
{{q1}}, everyone receives the same training.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 先辨識前文列出的選項，再判斷後句是共同結果、對比，還是另一種做法。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q2}}.

options.label: A
options.text: Your trainer will turn it into a printed checklist for employees to follow.

options.label: B
options.text: Your trainer will turn it into a model reply for employees to study.

options.label: C
options.text: Your trainer will turn it into a short role-play for two employees.

options.label: D
options.text: Your trainer will turn it into a written quiz for employees to complete.

explanation.summary_zh: 插入句須先建立兩人角色演練，才能銜接後文交換角色的活動。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前句請客戶提供一個常見顧客問題，空格中的 it 必須承接這個問題。後句的 The pair 又需要前文先交代兩名參與者，並說他們會交換顧客與員工角色。將問題改編成兩人角色演練，正好連接問題素材與後續練習方式。

option_analysis.label: A

content.title: Lunch for the Book-Repair Day
content.scenario_summary: Mara Ellis of Pell & Quill Conservation emails Neston Kitchen after a successful trial lunch for six conservators. Boxed sandwiches fit the studio's narrow trolley, and an insulated soup dispenser kept soup warm during staggered staff breaks. She requests a quotation for eighteen lunches, including six vegetarian portions, for one volunteer book-repair day on June 12. She wants the same menu but an earlier delivery, at 11:30 A.M. instead of noon. Everything must go to the break room because food is prohibited in the restoration room. The restaurant is asked to collect the reusable dispenser at 4 P.M., and the order will be confirmed only after a quotation is received.

blocks.text: To: Catering Team <catering@nestonkitchen.example>
From: Mara Ellis <mara@pellquill.example>
Date: May 28
Subject: Lunch for our volunteer book-repair day
Hello,

The trial lunch you delivered for our six conservators last week was a success. The boxed sandwiches fitted on our narrow trolley, and the insulated soup dispenser kept the soup warm while staff took staggered breaks.

We'd like the same menu for our volunteer book-repair day on June 12: eighteen lunches, including six vegetarian portions. Please deliver at 11:30 A.M. rather than noon, the time used for the trial. Bring everything to the break room; food is not allowed in the restoration room.
Please collect the reusable dispenser at 4 P.M. Could you send a price quotation for this order before we confirm?

Best regards,
Mara Ellis
Studio Coordinator, Pell & Quill Conservation

content.title: Fresh Eyes for the App Trial

content.title: Choose How Your Order Leaves the Warehouse
content.scenario_summary: Selnor Trade Supply responds to customers who prefer fewer stock deliveries by adding a checkout choice for orders containing unavailable items. Send as ready dispatches available items on the next working day and other items when stocked. Send together waits for all items for up to ten working days from the order date. Both options have a single $8 dispatch charge per order, and the choice can be changed until packing begins. If a Send together order is incomplete after the waiting period, available goods ship first and the balance follows when stocked at no additional dispatch charge. The options do not guarantee an arrival date and exclude furniture, whose deliveries require separate arrangements with the delivery team.

content.title: Shared Equipment for the Garden Work Party
content.scenario_summary: Fenmere Community Garden allocates its two handcarts and one covered workbench during a May 18 work party. Cart A is reserved for the path crew from 9 to 10 A.M. and the seedling crew from 10 to 11:30 A.M. Cart B is reserved for the compost crew from 9:30 to 11 A.M. The propagation crew has the covered workbench from 10:30 A.M. to noon. Carts must be returned to the shed by each slot's end, when the next user may collect them. Idle equipment remains reserved during its assigned slot, while unreserved equipment may be used after checking with the coordinator. Thus, a member asking for a cart at 10:15 cannot borrow one immediately but can be offered Cart B at 11 without altering any reservation.

content.title: A Visit to Signs of the Street
content.scenario_summary: A visitor reviews Signs of the Street after roof repairs move it from Marrin Museum's East Gallery to Bell Yard Hall, a former print workshop. She enjoys the working printing press and notes that its demonstrations finish at 4 P.M., before the exhibition closes at 7. blocks.text: A Fitting New Home for Signs of the Street
Review by Leah Orton

Signs of the Street has moved from Marrin Museum's East Gallery to Bell Yard Hall, a former print workshop, while the gallery roof is repaired. I followed the relocation e-mail's map there on Saturday and waited outside for the doors to open. [[1]] Once the doors opened, staff scanned the code on my original ticket.

My first stop was the desk offering free printed guides and audio headsets. I chose a guide, but holding it open made it awkward to sketch the old shop signs. [[2]] After that exchange, I could keep my sketchbook open while listening to the descriptions.

The hall also gives a working printing press its own corner. I watched a printer produce a small card, which visitors were allowed to keep. Watching the letters appear on paper held my attention longer than the display cases did. The final demonstration ends at 4 P.M., although the exhibition remains open until 7 P.M. [[3]]
I hope to bring my colleague next Saturday; on weekdays, she cannot leave work until 4:30 P.M. [[4]] The signs are attractive on their own, but the live press is what makes this show worth the trip.

content.title: Managing Recycling Collection Records
content.scenario_summary: Fernbank Paper Recovery explains how business customers choose e-mail or postal delivery for collection records. A saved Profile preference supplies the default for bookings created afterward, while Bookings allows a one-time format change before the paper is collected. Confirming a collection generates a reference that customers put on sack labels and keep for later enquiries. The record is prepared after the paper is weighed at the depot and delivered according to the format saved in the customer's booking.

blocks.text: Managing Your Collection Records
Fernbank Paper Recovery | Guide for business customers

Each collection record lists the weight of paper received and the collection reference. Choose an e-mail attachment or a printed copy sent by post. Both formats contain the same information and cost the same.
1. Profile

Sign in and open Profile > Record preference. Select E-mail or Post, check the corresponding address, and save. This default is copied into bookings created after you save it. Changing the profile does not alter bookings already confirmed. [[1]]
2. Confirm and label

Create the collection booking by entering the pickup date and number of sacks, then select Confirm collection. [[2]] Copy this reference onto every sack's label so depot staff can match the paper to your booking.
3. Bookings

For a one-time format change before your paper is collected, open Bookings, select the relevant booking and edit Record format. Save without changing Profile. This selection affects only the booking you opened. [[3]]
4. Receiving your record
Records are prepared after your paper is weighed at the depot, then delivered using the format saved in your booking. Keep the collection reference if you need to ask about a missing record. [[4]]

content.title: Match-Day Lunch Point
content.scenario_summary: Vale & Spoon Restaurant expands its outdoor Match-Day Lunch Point catering after all three organizers from an April pilot at Westridge Sports Park rebook for summer. The service provides 40–120 lunch boxes, delivery and counter setup, and an optional one-hour attendant. An introductory first-order offer waives only the $45 delivery/setup fee for June events confirmed by May 15 with a final order of at least 60 boxes. blocks.text: LUNCH READY BETWEEN MATCHES
Match-Day Lunch Point from Vale & Spoon Restaurant

After a three-event April pilot at Westridge Sports Park, our Match-Day Lunch Point is now open to all local sports clubs. All three event organizers have booked us again for summer. We deliver a counter and lunch boxes sorted by team, ready for your break between matches.
Choose the service your event needs
rows: Chicken or roasted-vegetable wrap, fruit and an oat cookie; 40–120 boxes per event
Parks within 8 km of the restaurant
Optional; otherwise, your club supplies the people who hand out the boxes

blocks.text: First-order launch offer
The $45 delivery/setup fee is waived on your first order for a June event confirmed by May 15, provided the final order contains at least 60 boxes.

Request a date at valespoon.example/sport with the park name and an estimated box count. We confirm availability by e-mail. Replace your estimate with a final box count and quantities for each wrap choice by noon, three working days before the event.

option_analysis.label: C

content.title: A Prop-Hire Trial for a Theater Production
content.scenario_summary: Crestwick Props advertises fixed trial packages that let theater companies evaluate its prop-hire service before annual membership. Haven Row Players' production manager reserves the Production package and asks an assistant to check four proposed arrangements. The quantity, duration and exchange fit that package, but delivery requires the Touring package. A separate request for advice on limited storage identifies the appropriate consultant through the advertisement.

blocks.text: Crestwick Props: Try Us on Your Next Production

Annual membership can wait. Our paid trials let theater companies use our hand-held props for one production before committing to regular hire. Every trial includes access to the online catalog and a warehouse appointment to inspect available items. These are fixed packages; services cannot be added separately.
Trial plans

The trial fee is credited toward annual membership if you join within 30 days after returning your props. Props remain Crestwick's property. Repairs and alterations are not allowed, but ordinary cleaning is included in the fee.
Each trial also includes one optional 20-minute consultation. Choose a topic when booking.
Consultation choices
Reserve at trials@crestwickprops.example. Trial plans are available throughout September.
From: Lena Foyle, Production Manager, Haven Row Players
To: Owen Mills, Production Assistant
Date: August 20
Subject: Prop-hire arrangements

Owen, I've reserved the Production trial for our September show. Before I send Crestwick our final request, please check that plan against our arrangements: nine props, a three-week hire, one exchange of two props, and delivery to the theater.
For the consultation, please choose the session on storage between performances. We have very little cupboard space, so advice on arranging it would be useful.

At the warehouse appointment, photograph the props we select. Our set designer will use the pictures to match the scenery colors; she cannot attend because she is supervising painting that afternoon. Keep the images in our shared production folder.

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 九月是試用方案的供應期間；廣告並未把試用說成年度會員既有的福利。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 符合先體驗再決定是否長期租借，以及符合期限可折抵會員費這兩項說明。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 廣告仍鼓勵試用者考慮年度會員，沒有說試用將取代偶爾租借者的會員資格。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 廣告沒有提出現有會員的優先預留權；重點是讓劇團在長期承諾前體驗服務。

evidence.quote: Our paid trials let theater companies use our hand-held props for one production before committing to regular hire.
The trial fee is credited toward annual membership if you join within 30 days after returning your props.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 判斷優惠的定位時，要連結開頭目的與後續附帶條件。

questions.prompt: According to the advertisement, which of the following is NOT included in the trial offer?

option_analysis.label: A

option_analysis.label: B

explanation.takeaway_zh: 否定細節題要逐一確認三項支持與一項不符的範圍。

questions.prompt: Why does Ms. Foyle ask Mr. Mills to take photographs?

option_analysis.label: C

content.title: Allocating Support at the Civic Connections Forum
content.scenario_summary: The Civic Connections Forum coordinator sets rules for allocating a limited volunteer pool: every session receives one volunteer, while sufficiently large hands-on workshops can receive a second unless a sponsor already supplies assistance. The operations manager supplies confirmed session information, identifies a chair who needs feedback packets, and reports that existing evening-roundtable reservations are still being serviced after the event is removed from the public booking page. Combining the emails identifies the sole session eligible for additional support and the correct packet contact for another chair.

blocks.text: From: Quinn Ames, Forum Coordinator
To: Isobel Keane, Operations Manager
Date: May 4
Subject: Volunteer and packet allocation

For the Civic Connections Forum on June 14, give each session one conference volunteer. A second volunteer may be allocated only to hands-on workshops with at least 40 registered participants. A session already receiving an assistant from a sponsoring organization cannot receive a second conference volunteer. This will keep our limited pool available where it is most needed.

Ask chairs to confirm their starting times, provide a mobile contact number, and send a short list of tasks for their volunteer by May 12. They should not contact volunteers directly before allocation is final.
Feedback packets will be available from the staff listed below. Each chair should collect their session's supply before registration opens.
Packet collection contacts

content.title: A Later Collection for Printed Packaging
content.scenario_summary: Brook Fen Foods moves its contract-packing day and then schedules a stockroom inventory count, asking Brindle Print & Pack to hold an existing packaging order until May 26. The invoice identifies four jobs and allows seven calendar days of free holding, excluding each actual completion date. The printer rearranges production and reports completion dates by job code. Matching one code identifies the recipe inserts completed on May 22; combining the requested collection date, the holding terms and all actual completion dates reveals that one job exceeds the free holding period.

blocks.text: From: Mara Dale, Operations Manager, Brook Fen Foods
To: Felix Ward, Brindle Print & Pack
Date: May 13
Subject: Invoice INV-6418—collection change

Our contract packers are now booked for May 27 instead of May 21. After that change was confirmed, we scheduled an inventory count, so the stockroom will be closed from May 19 through May 25. Please change our collection of the entire order from May 20 to May 26. We can then bring the printed materials straight into the stockroom before the packers arrive.

You may rearrange the production sequence, provided all four jobs are ready for that collection. The approved artwork and quantities should remain unchanged. Please label the outer cartons with the job codes so our packers can identify the contents without opening every carton.
Brindle Print & Pack
Invoice: INV-6418 | Issued: May 2
Bill to: Brook Fen Foods, 17 Bower Lane
Original collection date: May 20 | Payment due: May 30
Printing order
Total for printing: $960

Storage terms: Each completed job may be held without charge for seven calendar days after its completion date. The completion date itself is not counted. A storage fee of $6 per job per day applies from the eighth day. Any storage charges are billed separately.
From: Felix Ward, Brindle Print & Pack
To: Mara Dale, Brook Fen Foods
Date: May 24
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-6418—collection change

We adjusted the production sequence to suit your revised collection request. All four jobs are finished. The table gives their actual completion dates; these are the dates used for the storage terms on your invoice.
Completed jobs

We have set aside the finished cartons for your collection in Bay 4. Each outer carton bears its job code, as requested. A warehouse employee can help load your vehicle when you arrive. Please give the invoice number at reception so the employee can locate your order promptly.

questions.prompt: What is Ms. Dale's main reason for writing the first email?

options.label: A
options.text: To coordinate the order's collection with revised packing arrangements

options.label: B
options.text: To reserve off-site space for stock during an inventory count

options.label: C
options.text: To arrange separate collections as the printing jobs are completed

options.label: D
options.text: To request clearer identification of carton contents for the packing team

explanation.summary_zh: 信件主軸是配合庫房盤點與包裝日程，將整筆訂單的取貨延後。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 庫房盤點到五月二十五日才結束，包裝人員則改為二十七日到場，因此 Dale 要把整批取貨改到二十六日，以銜接兩項安排。外箱標示也是信中要求，但屬於方便包裝人員辨識內容的次要事項，不能概括這封改期郵件的主要目的。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 二十六日取貨位在庫房盤點結束之後、包裝人員到場之前，完整涵蓋調整整批取貨以配合作業安排的主旨。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 盤點是庫房暫時無法使用的原因；信中要印刷商保留的是尚未取走的印刷品，沒有要求替公司現有庫存另訂場外存放空間。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 她允許調整生產順序，但指定同一次領取整筆訂單，且四項工作都要在那次取貨前備妥，並非各自完工就分別領取。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 要求外箱標示代碼確實可讓包裝人員更容易辨識內容，但這是次要作業要求；主要變更仍是配合新時程延後整批取貨。

evidence.quote: Our contract packers are now booked for May 27 instead of May 21. After that change was confirmed, we scheduled an inventory count, so the stockroom will be closed from May 19 through May 25. Please change our collection of the entire order from May 20 to May 26. We can then bring the printed materials straight into the stockroom before the packers arrive.
You may rearrange the production sequence, provided all four jobs are ready for that collection.
Please label the outer cartons with the job codes so our packers can identify the contents without opening every carton.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 主要目的題要分清整體作業變更與信末附帶的執行要求。

questions.prompt: Which of the following is NOT stated in Mr. Ward's email?

options.label: A
options.text: Every printing job has been completed.

options.label: B
options.text: The outer cartons show the relevant job codes.

options.label: C
options.text: The customer's outstanding balance has been paid.

options.label: D
options.text: A staff member can assist with loading the vehicle.

explanation.summary_zh: Ward 確認完工、標示與裝車協助，但沒有說客戶已付清款項。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 第二封郵件明列四項工作全部完成，外箱有工作代碼，倉庫員工可協助裝車。提到提供發票號碼是為了快速找到訂單，並不代表已確認付款；該郵件沒有說明款項是否已清償。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: All four jobs are finished 明確支持每項印刷工作都已完成，因此此項確實有說明。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: Each outer carton bears its job code 明確說每個外箱都標有工作代碼。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 郵件沒有確認付款狀態；提供發票號碼只是取貨辨識程序，不能據此認定餘款已付清。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 郵件說倉庫員工可以協助裝載車輛，因此此項有明確依據。

evidence.quote: All four jobs are finished.

Each outer carton bears its job code, as requested. A warehouse employee can help load your vehicle when you arrive. Please give the invoice number at reception so the employee can locate your order promptly.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 發票號碼可用來辨識訂單，但未必表示發票款項已經支付。

questions.prompt: In Mr. Ward's email, the phrase "set aside" is closest in meaning to

explanation.summary_zh: 此處 set aside 指把已完工紙箱保留在指定區域，等待客戶領取。
explanation.reasoning_zh: set aside 有不予考量、撤銷或暫緩處理等用法，但這一句的受詞是已完工紙箱，並接著說供客戶在第四區取貨。這個實體存放位置與取貨用途表明紙箱被保留待領，因此 reserved 符合此處語意。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: disregarded 是不予理會或不列入考量；雖然 set aside 可用於擱置某項考量，本句卻是在說把實體成品留在指定區域供領取，不是忽略它們。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: canceled 是取消或撤銷；set aside 用於決定等事物時可有撤銷之意，但此處紙箱仍準備供客戶取走，沒有取消訂單的意思。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: postponed 是延後處理。雖然取貨日期已改期，這一句說的是已完工紙箱在第四區待領，不是在把某項工作或決定延後處理。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: reserved 表示保留供特定用途，符合把已完成的紙箱留在第四區，等待這位客戶來取的情境。

evidence.quote: We have set aside the finished cartons for your collection in Bay 4.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 多義片語要連同受詞、地點與用途判斷，不能只套用熟悉的字義。

questions.prompt: Which item was completed on May 22?

explanation.summary_zh: 完工表的 4279 是五月二十二日，發票把 4279 對應為食譜插頁。
explanation.reasoning_zh: Ward 的郵件只列工作代碼與日期，五月二十二日對應 4279。回到發票的品項表，4279 的名稱是 Recipe inserts，因此答案是食譜插頁。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: Carton sleeves 的代碼是 9607，完工表列其日期為五月十九日，不是二十二日。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: Recipe inserts 的代碼是 4279，與完工表五月二十二日那一列一致。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: Gift tags 的代碼是 8053，實際完工日為五月二十三日。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: Pouch labels 的代碼是 5834，實際完工日為五月十六日。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 日期表只提供代碼時，要用另一份文件的品項表完成對照。

questions.prompt: How many of the printing jobs will incur storage charges if Ms. Dale collects the entire order on her requested date?

explanation.summary_zh: 二十六日取貨時，只有一項工作超過完工後七個日曆日的免費暫存期限。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 第一封郵件指定五月二十六日取貨。條款明定不計完工當日，從次日起七個日曆日免費。5834 在十六日完工，免費期為十七日至二十三日，取貨時已收費；9607 的免費期為二十日至二十六日，仍免費。其餘兩項於二十二日及二十三日完工，也在免費期內，因此收費項數為一。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 5834 的免費期在五月二十三日結束，二十六日取貨已超過期限，所以不是全部免收暫存費。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 第二早完工的 9607 是五月十九日完成；完工日不計入，二十日至二十六日恰為七個免費日，不能把它也計為收費項目。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 二十二日及二十三日完成的工作到取貨日僅經過四天及三天，9607 也仍在第七個免費日，因此不會四項全部收費。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 只有五月十六日完成的 5834 超過免費期限；另外三項在二十六日取貨時都仍免費，故只有一項收費。

evidence.quote: Please change our collection of the entire order from May 20 to May 26.

Each completed job may be held without charge for seven calendar days after its completion date. The completion date itself is not counted. A storage fee of $6 per job per day applies from the eighth day.
The table gives their actual completion dates; these are the dates used for the storage terms on your invoice.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 先找確切取貨日，再按照條款的起算方式逐項核對免費天數。

content.title: Replacing a Scanner Used with ShelfCue
content.scenario_summary: ShelfCue sells inventory-software subscriptions, with a scanner and counter stand included in its Annual plan. An annual subscriber submits his first scanner-replacement request and lists cordless operation, a weight limit and compatibility with his existing stand as requirements. Support confirms a manufacturing fault but explains that the original model has been discontinued. Comparing four offered models with the request identifies the suitable replacement; combining the subscription record, fault confirmation and advertised replacement terms shows that only the universal delivery fee is payable.

blocks.text: ShelfCue: One Stock List Wherever You Work

Keep your shop and market-stall stock records together. Staff can update quantities from any location, and everyone works from the same current list. Every subscription includes barcode entry, daily cloud backups and exports to spreadsheet files.
Choose your subscription
rows: One scanner and counter stand included

blocks.text: During the first twelve months of an Annual subscription, the first scanner replacement for a confirmed manufacturing fault has no unit charge. This benefit covers any model we offer as a replacement. Other scanner replacements cost $85 per unit. A $12 delivery fee applies to every replacement, including those with no unit charge.
Explore ShelfCue at shelfcue.example or contact our sales team for a demonstration using sample stock records.
Hardware Replacement Order Form

Available replacement scanners

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of Ms. Perrin's email?

options.label: A
options.text: To request permission to inspect the original scanner for faults

options.label: B
options.text: To obtain a replacement choice after finding the original model unavailable

options.label: C
options.text: To request software changes before another scanner can be connected

options.label: D
options.text: To confirm shipment of the same scanner model under an existing agreement

explanation.summary_zh: 原型號已停產，Perrin 提供其他機型並請客戶選擇替換品。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 郵件先確認檢查結果，再交代 E7 已停產，無法供應相同機型，因此列出四種可用替換品。結尾要求回覆機型選擇與確認地址，表示目前要完成的是選定替換品，而非徵求檢查許可或確認已出貨。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 檢查已完成並確認製造瑕疵，郵件不是在徵求檢查原機的同意。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 相同型號因停產無法提供，郵件列出替代機型並要求客戶選擇，正是寫信目的。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 郵件說四種機型都能搭配 ShelfCue 使用，沒有要求修改軟體才可連接。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 相同機型已無法供應，且要等客戶選定機型、確認地址後才安排出貨，因此不是確認相同機型已寄出。

evidence.quote: Our inspection confirms that your E7 has a manufacturing fault. That model has been discontinued, so we cannot supply an identical unit.
Please reply with your model choice and confirm the delivery address on your form. We will then arrange dispatch and email a tracking link.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 目的題可依已完成的步驟與結尾要求，辨認目前待處理的行動。

questions.prompt: According to the advertisement, which of the following is NOT included with every subscription?

options.label: C
options.text: The ability to export information to a spreadsheet

options.label: D
options.text: The ability to enter information using barcodes

explanation.summary_zh: 掃描器只包含在 Annual 方案中，並非所有訂閱方案都提供。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 廣告明說所有訂閱都有條碼輸入、每日雲端備份與試算表匯出功能。方案表則區分 Monthly 要使用自備的相容掃描器，Annual 才包含一台掃描器與支架，因此提供實體掃描器不是每個方案都有的項目。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: daily cloud backups 列在 Every subscription includes 之後，表示每個方案都有每日備份。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: Annual 包含掃描器，但 Monthly 要使用自備的相容掃描器，所以此項不是所有方案都包含。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: exports to spreadsheet files 是所有訂閱共同提供的功能，支持匯出至試算表。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: barcode entry 明列為所有訂閱的共同功能，因此使用條碼輸入資料有包含在每個方案中。

evidence.quote: Every subscription includes barcode entry, daily cloud backups and exports to spreadsheet files.
Monthly | $29 per month | Use your own compatible scanner
Annual | $290 per year | One scanner and counter stand included

explanation.takeaway_zh: 注意 every 的範圍，共同軟體功能不代表所有方案都附相同硬體。

questions.prompt: In Ms. Perrin's email, the word "fault" is closest in meaning to

explanation.summary_zh: manufacturing fault 在此指製造上的瑕疵，最接近 defect。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 檢查結果指出掃描器本身有 manufacturing fault，接著安排替換機，因此 fault 描述的是產品瑕疵。這裡不是追究某人的責任，也不是指客訴或一次服務中斷。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: fault 在其他語境可涉及過錯責任，但本句說掃描器有製造上的問題，responsibility 無法表達產品瑕疵。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: defect 指產品的缺陷或瑕疵，符合經檢查確認的 manufacturing fault。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: complaint 是投訴；此處是檢查後確認設備本身的狀況，不是描述客戶提出的投訴。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: interruption 是中斷，與本句所指的製造瑕疵不同；郵件也沒有用此字描述服務停擺。

evidence.quote: Our inspection confirms that your E7 has a manufacturing fault.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 多義字要依它描述的對象與搭配詞判斷，此處是產品的製造瑕疵。

questions.prompt: Which replacement satisfies all the requirements on Mr. Sato's form?

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: H2N 重量一百九十五公克且相容 ST6，但操作方式為有線，不符合無線要求。

option_analysis.label: B

option_analysis.label: C

option_analysis.label: D

evidence.quote: Replacement requirements: Cordless operation, a weight of no more than 220 grams, and compatibility with our existing ST6 stand.
