content.title: PedalBridge Bike Day Moves to New Sites
content.scenario_summary: PedalBridge publishes services and appointment procedures for a community bicycle-repair day at a park pavilion. A resident asks about her own repair offer after uploading photos promptly but sending the required serial-number reply two days after the offer. Her son already has a confirmed puncture-repair lesson. The pavilion is subsequently closed, and an internal memo allocates the four activities to nearby sites. The booking deadline establishes that the mother's offer expired, while the child's distinct confirmed activity identifies the correct replacement venue.

documents.title: PedalBridge Bike Day Services and Bookings

blocks.text: PedalBridge Bike Day
September 6 | Larch Park Pavilion | Page updated: August 8

Our volunteer mechanics carry out minor repairs, while booked puncture-repair lessons help cyclists learn to fix their own tires. You can also donate usable spare parts or collect bicycles finished at earlier clinics. Please bring your bicycle to any lesson you attend.

For a mechanic appointment, submit the online registration form to join the waiting list. If we offer you a slot, accept by replying to that message with your bicycle's serial number. Offers expire at 5 P.M. on the following calendar day if not accepted. You may also upload repair photographs to help the mechanic prepare. Lesson bookings are confirmed separately through the classes page.

documents.title: A Resident Checks Her Bike Day Arrangements

blocks.text: From: Mina Arden
To: bookings@pedalbridge.example
Date: August 24
Subject: Our Bike Day bookings
My son Noel has a confirmed place in the 10:30 puncture-repair lesson, reference 6384.

For my own bicycle, I submitted the repair registration form on August 18 and received a slot offer on August 22. I uploaded photographs that afternoon and sent a reply with the serial number this morning. Could you confirm whether that completes my booking?
Internal Memo: Bike Day Relocation
To: Event team | From: Aisha Bell, Coordinator | Date: September 3

The council has closed Larch Park Pavilion for electrical repairs. To keep Bike Day running on September 6, we have arranged the nearby sites below. Use the existing confirmed booking lists; visitors do not need to register again.
Replacement locations

Please clear the pavilion of customer bicycles by 4 P.M. on September 4. Move the finished bicycles to Wye Cycle Shop and take the teaching equipment to the hall. Direct callers using the table until the updated webpage goes live this afternoon.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the memo?

options.label: A
options.text: To organize the transfer of finished bicycles to a local cycle shop

options.label: B
options.text: To ask visitors to reapply for activities at alternative venues

options.label: C
options.text: To arrange bicycle storage until Bike Day can be rescheduled

options.label: D
options.text: To coordinate staff preparations for providing services at new sites

explanation.summary_zh: 備忘錄要工作人員安排搬運與引導，讓活動在替代場地如期進行。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 原場地因電力維修關閉，但備忘錄明說要讓九月六日的活動繼續舉行，因此列出四項服務的新地點，並指示搬移自行車、教學設備及答覆來電。搬車只是其中一項；整體目的在協調全部服務的換場地準備，並非要求重新報名或等待延期。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 把已修好的車搬到車店確實是其中一項指示，但只涵蓋領車安排；備忘錄還協調其他活動的新場地與訪客引導，主要目的更廣。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 備忘錄要求沿用已確認的預約名單，並明說訪客不用重新登記，所以不是要求改向新場地報名。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 搬移自行車確實是一項指示，但活動仍在九月六日進行；備忘錄中不是先存車、等待另訂活動日期。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 新場地表、車輛與設備搬運，以及電話引導方式，都是工作人員為服務換場地所需的協調準備。

evidence.quote: The council has closed Larch Park Pavilion for electrical repairs. To keep Bike Day running on September 6, we have arranged the nearby sites below.
Use the existing confirmed booking lists; visitors do not need to register again.
Move the finished bicycles to Wye Cycle Shop and take the teaching equipment to the hall. Direct callers using the table until the updated webpage goes live this afternoon.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 整體目的要涵蓋多項工作指示，並區分換場地與延期舉辦。

questions.prompt: Which service is NOT listed on the Bike Day webpage?

options.label: B
options.text: Minor repairs performed by volunteer mechanics

options.label: C
options.text: Loan bicycles for customers whose bicycles are being repaired

options.label: D
options.text: A drop-off point for reusable bicycle parts

explanation.summary_zh: 網頁列出維修、教學與零件捐贈等服務，沒有列出代步車借用。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 網頁說志工做小型維修、提供補胎課程、接受可用備用零件，並讓訪客領取先前修好的車。這些資訊都沒有表示維修期間可以借用另一輛自行車，因此代步車是唯一未列出的服務。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: puncture-repair lessons 是補胎課程，網頁也說課程幫助騎士學習自行修補輪胎，因此有列出。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 網頁明說志工技師執行 minor repairs，直接支持由志工提供小型維修。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 領取已修好的車不等於借用替代車；網頁沒有列出維修期間提供代步自行車的服務。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 訪客可捐出仍可使用的備用零件，表示活動接受這類零件捐贈，符合可送交零件的地點。

evidence.quote: Our volunteer mechanics carry out minor repairs, while booked puncture-repair lessons help cyclists learn to fix their own tires. You can also donate usable spare parts or collect bicycles finished at earlier clinics.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 未列出服務的題目要核對文字範圍，不能把領車誤讀成借車。

questions.prompt: In the memo, the word "clear" is closest in meaning to

explanation.summary_zh: clear the pavilion of customer bicycles 指把客戶自行車從館內清走。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 句型 clear a place of something 表示把指定物品從某處移除。這裡要在期限前把客戶自行車搬出原場地，後文也要求把已修好的車移至車店，因此 empty 最接近此處的動作，並非指清走館內所有其他物品。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: empty the pavilion of customer bicycles 可表達把客戶自行車清出場館，與後面的搬車指示一致。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: clear 在其他情境可表示核准，但本句要把自行車移出場館，不是在核准場地或車輛使用。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: settle 可表示結清或解決；本句的場館與自行車是實體搬運對象，沒有債務或爭議需要處理。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: clear 用於障礙物時可表示越過，但此處不是穿越場館，而是將自行車從場館清出。

evidence.quote: Please clear the pavilion of customer bicycles by 4 P.M. on September 4. Move the finished bicycles to Wye Cycle Shop and take the teaching equipment to the hall.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 動詞的受詞與後接片語可限定字義；此處 of 後面標出要移除的物品。

questions.prompt: According to the published booking procedure, what happened to Ms. Arden's mechanic-slot offer?

options.label: A
options.text: It was confirmed by her serial-number reply.

options.label: B
options.text: It expired before she sent the required reply.

options.label: C
options.text: It was still awaiting her initial registration form.

options.label: D
options.text: It remained open when her latest email was sent.

explanation.summary_zh: 她二十二日收到時段邀請，卻到二十四日才回傳車身序號，已超過隔日截止時間。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 網頁要求收到時段邀請後，最晚在下一個日曆日下午五點前回覆自行車序號。她八月二十二日收到邀請，因此截止日是二十三日；二十四日郵件所說的當天早上才寄序號已經太晚。先上傳照片是供技師準備，沒有取代所要求的回覆。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 回覆序號是接受邀請的必要步驟，但她寄出時已超過二十三日下午五點的期限，不能依公告程序視為及時確認。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 二十二日的邀請在二十三日下午五點到期，她到二十四日早上才寄出必要回覆，所以邀請先到期。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 她已在八月十八日提交初始登記表，之後才收到時段邀請，不是還欠初始表格。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 最新郵件的日期是八月二十四日，已晚於二十三日的邀請截止時間，因此邀請並未仍然有效。

evidence.quote: If we offer you a slot, accept by replying to that message with your bicycle's serial number. Offers expire at 5 P.M. on the following calendar day if not accepted.
You may also upload repair photographs to help the mechanic prepare.
Date: August 24

For my own bicycle, I submitted the repair registration form on August 18 and received a slot offer on August 22. I uploaded photographs that afternoon and sent a reply with the serial number this morning.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 先確認哪個動作才算接受預約，再用郵件日期解讀當天早上等相對時間。

questions.prompt: Where should Ms. Arden take Noel for his confirmed activity?

explanation.summary_zh: Noel 已確認的是補胎課，而備忘錄把補胎課安排在 Hewitt Community Hall。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 電子郵件指出 Noel 的已確認活動是十點半的 puncture-repair lesson。備忘錄的場地表將這項活動對應到 Hewitt Community Hall，因此應帶他到該處上課。單看場地表不知道他報名哪項活動，單看預約郵件也沒有新場地。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: Ormond Sports Centre 接受備用零件捐贈，不是 Noel 已預約的補胎課地點。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: Wye Cycle Shop 是領取已修好自行車的地點；Noel 確認的是課程，不是領車。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: Cypress Library courtyard 接待技師維修預約，與 Noel 的補胎教學課程不同。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 場地表把 Puncture-repair lessons 對應至 Hewitt Community Hall，正好符合 Noel 已確認的活動。

evidence.quote: My son Noel has a confirmed place in the 10:30 puncture-repair lesson, reference 6384.
Puncture-repair lessons | Hewitt Community Hall

explanation.takeaway_zh: 先從個人預約確認活動類型，再用場地變更表找到對應地點。
